name: Texas Attorney General data security breach reports
regulator: Texas Office of the Attorney General
unit_of_observation: One public data security breach report listing row
source_threshold: The public reporting requirement applies to data breaches affecting at least 250 Texas residents, subject to the official statutory guidance.
source_population: Reports submitted to the Texas Office of the Attorney General and displayed in its public listing.
public_window: A changing public listing rendered through a stateful hosted application.
source_licence: No explicit redistribution licence was identified for the reviewed listing. The public application also exposes address fields that require a separate minimisation decision.
attribution: Texas Office of the Attorney General
correction_process: Review the official reporting page and public listing; do not infer absence from an incomplete or inaccessible listing.
limitations: Rows are loaded through a stateful hosted application using transient request tokens rather than a stable public export.
The application exposes street-address fields that require an explicit privacy-minimisation review.
No source-specific redistribution licence was identified.
Browser automation and transient session endpoints are deliberately unsupported.
A missing or inaccessible row cannot be treated as evidence that no report exists.
